name: Bhedaghat
description: Bhedaghat is a renowned gorge on the Narmada River near Jabalpur, Madhya Pradesh, famous for marble-like limestone cliffs and boat rides through the Marble Rocks. The adjacent Dhuandhar Falls is a major waterfall where the river narrows and plunges with heavy mist.
shortDescription: Marble Rocks gorge and Dhuandhar Falls on the Narmada near Jabalpur.
history: The Marble Rocks (Bhedaghat) have long been a pilgrimage and sightseeing corridor on the Narmada; the Dhuandhar cascade is a well-known natural landmark in the region.
